capabilities.body: OpenAmer imakonza ntchito, kuichita ndi zida zenizeni — potumizira malamulo, msakatuli, mafayilo, khodi — ndipo imasunga zomwe zagwira bwino.
capabilities.title: Wothandizira amene amaganiza nanu

capabilities.body: Zokambirana, zokumbukira ndi mitundu ya luntha lochita kupanga zimakhala pa kompyuta iyi. Palibe chomwe chimatumizidwa pokhapokha mutapempha.
capabilities.title: Zipangizo zanu, deta yanu

capabilities.body: Zinenero 186, chilichonse m'malembo amene mumawerenga. Tsamba loyamba la pulogalamuyi limakufunsani kusankha chinenero.
capabilities.title: Chinenero chanu, moyenera

capabilities.body: Maluso amasungidwa kuchokera kuntchito yeniyeni, motero ntchito za tsiku ndi tsiku zimachepa nthawi pamene mukuigwiritsa ntchito.
capabilities.title: Luso lomwe likukula

help: Onetsetsani kuti kompyuta iyi imatha kulumikiza intaneti.
Yambitsaninso kukonza koyambirira — magawo omalizidwa sabwerezedwa.
Ikalephera kawiri, tsegulani zolemba; mizere yomaliza imatchula gawo lomwe lalephera.
failure.lead: Palibe zosintha zomwe zabwezeretsedwa mwakachetechete — OpenAmer imayima pomwe yayimira, kotero kuyambitsanso kumapitiriza kuchokera pamenepo.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ikadali pa mtundu wakale ndipo ikugwirabe ntchito. Palibe chomwe chasinthidwa theka lokha.
failure.title: Kukonza koyambirira sikunathe

language.lead: Kukonza koyambirira kupitiriza m'chinenero chomwe mwasankha pano. Mutha kuchisintha pambuyo pake mu pulogalamuyi.
language.title: Sankhani chinenero chanu

progress.lead: Kukonza koyamba kokha: OpenAmer ikutsitsa zofunika ndi kukonza kompyuta iyi. Mukadzaiyambitsanso, zonsezi sizidzabwerezedwa.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ikulowa m'malo mwa mtundu wakale. Magawo anu ogwirira ntchito, zokumbukira ndi zoikamo sizikhudzidwa.
progress.title: Ikukonza OpenAmer

stages.configure: Ikukonza makiyi a API ndi mitundu ya luntha lochita kupanga
stages.platform-sdks: Ikuika ma SDK a nsanja zotumizirana mauthenga

cards.body: Tsegulani pulogalamuyi ndipo fotokozani zomwe mukufuna zichitike. OpenAmer imagwira ntchito kumbuyo ndi kukubweretserani zotsatira.
cards.title: Yambani ndi chiganizo

cards.body: Zoikamo → Mawonekedwe → Chinenero. Zosankha za zinenero ndi madera 186, zosinthika nthawi iliyonse.
cards.title: Sankhani chinenero chanu

cards.body: Ntchito yobwerezabwereza imakhala luso — ulendo wotsatira imangofuna lamulo limodzi.
cards.title: Iloleni ikumbukire

success.command: kapena iyambitseni pambuyo pake kuchokera potumizira malamulo:
success.lead: Zonse zili m'malo. OpenAmer tsopano ndi yanu — pa kompyuta iyi, m'chinenero chanu.
success.title: OpenAmer yakonzeka

bullets: Imagwira ntchito pa kompyuta yanu — zokambirana zanu zimakhalabe pa kompyuta iyi
Zonse zitha kusinthidwa pambuyo pake; palibe chokhalitsa
welcome.lead: Wothandizira wanu. Pa zipangizo zanu. M'chinenero chanu.
welcome.leadUpdate: OpenAmer yatsopano yakonzeka. Ilowa m'malo mwa mtundu wakale ndikusunga magawo onse ogwirira ntchito ndi zoikamo zonse.
welcome.note: Zimatenga mphindi zochepa pa intaneti yabwinobwino.
welcome.title: Takulandirani ku OpenAmer
